name: Mesh Processing
description: Triangle mesh operations: subdivision, simplification, and conversion to point clouds via uniform or Poisson-disk sampling.

videos.title: 3D Mesh, Point Cloud & Volume Processing with Open3D
Mesh, Voxels & Volumes: Binary Erosion and Marching Cubes

theory.overview:
Mesh processing operates on triangle meshes $\mathcal{M} = (V, F)$. Key operations include:

**Subdivision** increases mesh resolution by splitting triangles. Midpoint subdivision inserts new vertices at edge midpoints, quadrupling the face count per iteration.

**Simplification** reduces complexity using Quadric Error Metrics (QEM) which iteratively collapses edges minimizing $\Delta(v) = v^T Q v$.

**Mesh-to-Point-Cloud sampling** converts surfaces to point sets via uniform or Poisson-disk sampling.

subdivision.title: Mesh Subdivision
subdivision.content: Midpoint subdivision splits each edge at its midpoint creating 4 new triangles from each original. After $k$ iterations: $|F| \cdot 4^k$ faces.

simplification.title: Mesh Simplification (QEM)
simplification.content: Quadric Error Metrics decimation collapses edges in order of increasing cost $v^T (Q_a + Q_b) v$ until the target triangle count is reached.

mesh_to_pcd_uniform.title: Uniform Surface Sampling
mesh_to_pcd_uniform.content: Points are sampled uniformly, each triangle receiving samples proportional to its area $A_i$.

mesh_to_pcd_poisson_disk.title: Poisson-Disk Sampling
mesh_to_pcd_poisson_disk.content: Blue-noise sampling where no two samples are closer than minimum distance $r$, producing more uniform coverage.

parameters.name: maximum_error
parameters.description: Advisory maximum quadric error allowed per edge collapse (very large = unbounded, matches default behavior).

parameters.name: boundary_weight
parameters.description: Weight applied to boundary edges during decimation.

parameters.name: use_triangle_normal
parameters.description: Assign each sampled point the normal of its source triangle instead of an interpolated vertex normal.

parameters.name: init_factor
parameters.description: Initial uniform-sample oversampling factor before elimination.

parameters.name: use_triangle_normal
parameters.description: Assign each sampled point the normal of its source triangle instead of an interpolated vertex normal.
